## Dataset Description and Loading

```{r}

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)
library(dplyr)
library(caret)

data <- read_excel("Dataset.xlsx")

str(data)

```



## Preprocessing Steps

```{r}

selected_columns <- c('overall', 'wage_eur', 'age', 'value_eur', 'pace', 
                      'shooting', 'passing', 'dribbling', 'defending', 
                      'physic', 'skill_moves', 'weak_foot')
data <- data[, selected_columns]

data <- na.omit(data)

missing_values <- sum(is.na(data))
cat("Number of missing values after preprocessing:", missing_values, "\n")

summary(data)

```



## Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data, aes(x = overall)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 30, fill = "blue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_density(color = "red", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Overall Ratings", x = "Overall Rating", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
library(corrplot)

correlation_matrix <- cor(data, use = "complete.obs")

corrplot(correlation_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper", tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45, 
         title = "Correlation Matrix of Player Attributes", mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0))
```


## VIF


```{r}
library(car)

vif_model <- lm(overall ~ wage_eur + age + value_eur + pace + shooting +
                  passing + dribbling + defending + physic + skill_moves +
                  weak_foot, data = data)

vif_values <- vif(vif_model)

vif_values
```



## Implementing Multiple Linear Regression


```{r}
linear_model <- lm(overall ~ ., data = data)
linear_model_summary <- summary(linear_model)

print(linear_model_summary)

predictions_linear <- predict(linear_model, newdata = data)

mse_linear <- mean((data$overall - predictions_linear)^2)
rmse_linear <- sqrt(mse_linear)

cat("MSE (Linear Regression):", mse_linear, "\n")
cat("RMSE (Linear Regression):", rmse_linear, "\n")

```


## Implementing Polynomial Regression

```{r}

data <- data %>% mutate(
  pace2 = pace^2,
  shooting2 = shooting^2,
  passing2 = passing^2,
  dribbling2 = dribbling^2,
  defending2 = defending^2,
  physic2 = physic^2
)

poly_model <- lm(overall ~ pace + pace2 + shooting + shooting2 + passing + passing2 +
                   dribbling + dribbling2 + defending + defending2 + physic + physic2 +
                   wage_eur + age + value_eur + skill_moves + weak_foot, data = data)

poly_model_summary <- summary(poly_model)

predictions_poly <- predict(poly_model, newdata = data)
mse_poly <- mean((data$overall - predictions_poly)^2)
rmse_poly <- sqrt(mse_poly)

cat("Polynomial Regression Model Summary:\n")
print(poly_model_summary)

cat("\nMSE (Polynomial Regression):", mse_poly, "\n")
cat("RMSE (Polynomial Regression):", rmse_poly, "\n")

```



## Ridge 

```{r}

library(glmnet)

x <- model.matrix(overall ~ ., data)[, -1]
y <- data$overall

ridge_model <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = 0, nfolds = 10)
ridge_best_lambda <- ridge_model$lambda.min

ridge_predictions <- predict(ridge_model, s = ridge_best_lambda, newx = x)
ridge_mse <- mean((y - ridge_predictions)^2)
ridge_rmse <- sqrt(ridge_mse)

cat("Ridge Regression:\n")
cat("Best Lambda:", ridge_best_lambda, "\n")
cat("MSE:", ridge_mse, "\n")
cat("RMSE:", ridge_rmse, "\n")

```


## Lasso Regression

```{r}
lasso_model <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = 1, nfolds = 10)
lasso_best_lambda <- lasso_model$lambda.min

lasso_predictions <- predict(lasso_model, s = lasso_best_lambda, newx = x)
lasso_mse <- mean((y - lasso_predictions)^2)
lasso_rmse <- sqrt(lasso_mse)

cat("Lasso Regression:\n")
cat("Best Lambda:", lasso_best_lambda, "\n")
cat("MSE:", lasso_mse, "\n")
cat("RMSE:", lasso_rmse, "\n")


```
```{r}
lasso_coefficients <- predict(lasso_model, s = lasso_best_lambda, type = "coefficients")
print(lasso_coefficients)

```



## Cross-Validation for Polynomial Regression

```{r}
library(caret)

set.seed(42) 

folds <- createFolds(data$overall, k = 10, list = TRUE, returnTrain = TRUE)

cv_mse_poly <- c()
cv_rmse_poly <- c()

for (i in 1:10) {
  train_indices <- folds[[i]]
  train_data <- data[train_indices, ]
  test_data <- data[-train_indices, ]

  poly_model_cv <- lm(overall ~ pace + I(pace^2) + shooting + I(shooting^2) +
                      passing + I(passing^2) + dribbling + I(dribbling^2) +
                      defending + I(defending^2) + physic + I(physic^2) +
                      wage_eur + age + value_eur + skill_moves + weak_foot, 
                      data = train_data)

  predictions_cv <- predict(poly_model_cv, newdata = test_data)

  mse <- mean((test_data$overall - predictions_cv)^2)
  rmse <- sqrt(mse)

  cv_mse_poly <- c(cv_mse_poly, mse)
  cv_rmse_poly <- c(cv_rmse_poly, rmse)
}

mean_mse_poly <- mean(cv_mse_poly)
mean_rmse_poly <- mean(cv_rmse_poly)

cat("Cross-Validation Results for Polynomial Regression:\n")
cat("Mean MSE:", mean_mse_poly, "\n")
cat("Mean RMSE:", mean_rmse_poly, "\n")

```



## Residual Analysis


```{r}


par(mfrow = c(2, 2))  
plot(poly_model)

```
```{r}
hist(residuals(poly_model), breaks = 30, col = "skyblue",
     main = "Histogram of Residuals", xlab = "Residuals")

```

```{r}

qqnorm(residuals(poly_model), main = "Q-Q Plot of Residuals")
qqline(residuals(poly_model), col = "red")

```



```{r}

cooks_distances <- cooks.distance(poly_model)

threshold <- 4 / length(cooks_distances)
high_leverage_points <- which(cooks_distances > threshold)

cat("Number of high-leverage points:", length(high_leverage_points), "\n")
cat("Indices of high-leverage points:", high_leverage_points, "\n")

plot(cooks_distances, type = "h", main = "Cook's Distance for Influential Points",
     xlab = "Observation", ylab = "Cook's Distance")
abline(h = threshold, col = "red", lty = 2)

data_cleaned <- data[-high_leverage_points, ]

cat("Number of observations after removing high-leverage points:", nrow(data_cleaned), "\n")

```

```{r}
poly_model_cleaned <- lm(overall ~ pace + I(pace^2) + shooting + I(shooting^2) + 
                         passing + I(passing^2) + dribbling + I(dribbling^2) +
                         defending + I(defending^2) + physic + I(physic^2) +
                         wage_eur + age + value_eur + skill_moves + weak_foot, 
                         data = data_cleaned)

summary(poly_model_cleaned)

predictions_cleaned <- predict(poly_model_cleaned, newdata = data_cleaned)
mse_cleaned <- mean((data_cleaned$overall - predictions_cleaned)^2)
rmse_cleaned <- sqrt(mse_cleaned)

cat("Polynomial Regression (Cleaned Data):\n")
cat("MSE:", mse_cleaned, "\n")
cat("RMSE:", rmse_cleaned, "\n")

library(caret)
set.seed(42)
folds <- createFolds(data_cleaned$overall, k = 10, list = TRUE)

cv_mse_cleaned <- c()
cv_rmse_cleaned <- c()

for (i in 1:10) {
  train_index <- folds[[i]]
  train_data <- data_cleaned[train_index, ]
  test_data <- data_cleaned[-train_index, ]
  
  poly_model_cv_cleaned <- lm(overall ~ pace + I(pace^2) + shooting + I(shooting^2) +
                              passing + I(passing^2) + dribbling + I(dribbling^2) +
                              defending + I(defending^2) + physic + I(physic^2) +
                              wage_eur + age + value_eur + skill_moves + weak_foot,
                              data = train_data)
  
  predictions_cv_cleaned <- predict(poly_model_cv_cleaned, newdata = test_data)
  mse_cv_cleaned <- mean((test_data$overall - predictions_cv_cleaned)^2)
  rmse_cv_cleaned <- sqrt(mse_cv_cleaned)
  
  cv_mse_cleaned <- c(cv_mse_cleaned, mse_cv_cleaned)
  cv_rmse_cleaned <- c(cv_rmse_cleaned, rmse_cv_cleaned)
}

cat("Cross-Validation Results (Cleaned Data):\n")
cat("Mean MSE:", mean(cv_mse_cleaned), "\n")
cat("Mean RMSE:", mean(cv_rmse_cleaned), "\n")

```
